How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your jewellery for the first time is so exciting! Here’s how to make the most of it:
Unbox with Care: Your piece will arrive in a lovely Abbott Lyon presentation box or envelope. If it’s a gift, you can upgrade to luxury packaging here.
Wear It Last: Put your jewellery on after applying cosmetics, perfumes, or lotions to avoid any contact that might dull its shine.
Daily Use: If it’s a stainless steel piece, it’s water and sweat-resistant, so it’s perfect for everyday wear. Just avoid harsh chemicals or abrasive surfaces.
Storage: When not wearing it, store your jewellery in its box to keep it safe and shiny.
Enjoy your beautiful new piece—it’s going to look amazing on you! 🧡
